notes.title: NecroCity Now in Full Release! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1][b]It's time to face the forces of so-called 'good' ⚔️[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]THE FULL VERSION of NecroCity is Now Available! 🥳[/b][/h1]

[h3]Get ready to embark on an epic journey into the heart of darkness, build your Undead Kingdom, and take on the role of the young Prince of Undead, trying to prove himself in the world of the Undead Kingdom! 👹[/h3]

[previewyoutube=1hurF3oLI40;full][/previewyoutube]

The entire NecorCity Team is incredibly happy to announce that the full version of the game is now available to play. After several months of hard work, dedication, and extremely valuable feedback from our community, we decided to release the game in the Full Version! 🎊


[b][u]Major Changes from Early Access to Full Version[/u] 😈[/b]
[list][*] 9 new levels
[*] 3 maps in the new Endless Mode
[*] A new mode in minimap - follow
[*] Added Steam Cloud 
[*] Added the ability to upgrade traps
[*] New biome
[*] More markings on the minimap
[*] Keyboard shortcuts for building
[*] UI scaling
[*] Improved text readability
[*] Improved tower upgrades
[*] Obelisks do not require connection to each other
[*] Improved spell cost
[*] Gameplay balance changes
[*] Fixed incorrect game detection by Steam
[*] Bugfixes
[*] The entire plot is fully ready[/list][b]AND MORE[/b]


[b][u]Thank You - For being with us during this time![/u] 🤝[/b]
We would like to thank every player who was with us, for your support, feedback, opinions, bug reports, and suggestions. We started with a demo and after several months of hard work, we released the Full Version of the game - this couldn't happen without your commitment.


[b][u]What's next for the Kingdom of the Undead?[/u] 🤔[/b]
Our adventure through the World of the Undead does not end here. We will continue to maintain our game and make improvements based on your feedback and suggestions. Therefore, we encourage you to share your opinion about the game and write your feedback to us.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1489310/discussions/0/3877095833478530777/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/50e97b65dc2d6637527ff21f5ce3177bee9608fb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Sign up for ENDLESS MODE Playtest!
notes.content:

[h2][b]Be a part of the game and sign up for the upcoming Playtest of the ENDLESS MODE! ⚔️[/b][/h2]


We would like to remind you that the game is currently available in Early Access and we decided to diversify the gameplay by adding a new mode to the game - [b]ENDLESS MODE[/b].

[previewyoutube=5XHEn7URixQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The main goal of Playtest is to provide us the possibility to test the game, from the best testers - PLAYERS! You will have unique access to the game and we can get valuable feedback. 😊

[h3][b][u]HOW TO SIGN UP FOR PLAYTEST?[/u] 📝[/b][/h3]
It is very simple, let us explain that step by step:
1. You must be logged into your Steam account. 
2. Then go to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489310/NecroCity/]game Steam page[/url]. 
3. Scroll a little lower on the Steam page 
4. You will see the banner like below, and click the green button "request access"

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489310/NecroCity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/145aaa406e17dc141ec19660c953a38e63b4f991.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Congratulations that's it! 🥳
[b]Now just wait for the email with the invite. 📫[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Remember that registration for Playtests is currently ongoing, so please be patient, we will inform you about it as soon as we send out the invitations. ✉️[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Let's talk about Early Access... 💬
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players, [/b][/h1]

[h3]We want to remind you that NecroCity will be available in Early Access and if you decided to support us, we really count on your feedback, ideas, and suggestions for the full version of the game.[/h3]

On the Steam Community Hub, we have created a separate thread for this. You can also send us your suggestions on our Discord.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1489310/discussions/0/3830914916569054212/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/f43929e76cea3471edd2603d6baf40200d973435.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1489310/discussions/0/3830914916569053812/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/473bfbd7b6a2d9f27f22a693091739acef09cd65.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]So where did the idea for Early Access come from?[/b][/u]
We decided that NecroCity will be available in Early Access because the game now has a lot to offer, and we have a lot of work ahead of us. We want to develop the game with our community, to better understand the expectations, also everyone who decides to support our journey from EA to Full Version can expect a much lower price as we believe that players who decide to buy the game now support our work and we want to appreciate players who decide to buy in Early Access.

[u][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/u]
To best understand the difference between Early Access, we encourage you to check out our Raod Map which is on the game's Steam page. However, the most important differences are:
- 9 new levels.
- The grand finale of the epic story of the prince and his loyal friends.
- New biome for the final stage of the game.
- Refining game mechanics.
And also we will consider every idea and suggestion from you - our community.



[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1489310/view/3717197837533257621][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/18cd9c59456749e770d59456119a0328060987e2.png[/img][/url]

If you have decided to buy NecroCity at Ealry Access, we would like to thank you for your support, and remember to share your impressions with us after playing, we count on your feedback, opinions, and suggestions!

If you have any further questions, feel free to chat with us on Discord. 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/qAtejkxrA8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/843dc6ddc2ff62506d346c0d3a4cf9e1149c5d47.png[/img][/url]

Thank you!
NecroCity Team

notes.title: Fighting System ⚔
notes.content:
[h1]Hello and Welcome! 👹[/h1]

Dear [b]Necromancers[/b], today we will be focusing on combat in the game. But before we begin, keep in mind that every change you see mentioned in this devlog is for you to experience in the demo available right [b]NOW![/b]  We will be going over how to take control over the battlefield by selecting units and which abilities should the selected members of the army use, how to summon them and how to select the monsters you want to command. 🧙‍♂️ 
[previewyoutube=u1KkkN2FFRU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Call the units[/h1]
To summon a unit simply look for a desired unit on the bottom right of the screen and click on it with the left mouse button, after that repeat the click on the desired place in the world.🌍

[h1]Selecting units[/h1]
After you’ve summoned your units its time to choose which ones will do what. Hold the left mouse button and drag it over the units you want to give orders to.

[h1]Targeting[/h1]
Our units are summoned, now it’s time to put our enemies in sight. To choose where to deploy your attack look to the bottom left of your screen and select the ability you want to be unleashed, after that take your mouse to a location where you need the spell and click your left mouse button again. 💥

[b]This concludes our news from the battlefield, feel free to let us know which units and abilities you like using the most. We wish you luck and courage on the battlefield.[/b] 🧛‍♂️

notes.title: DEVLOG #6 | PASSIVE BUILDINGS
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello and Welcome![/b][/h3]

Dear fans In NecroCity there are several types of buildings in the game - main, production, passive, active and mod. In today's devlog we will present to you almost all types of passive buildings. All of them can be placed on suitable empty tiles of the appropriate size by the player, as long as there's enough resources to build it.

[b]The Passive Buildings category includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Production
[*] Cooldown
[*] Damage
[*] Status
[*] Defense
[*] Health
[/list]
Provide buffs in a certain radius, upgrades increase this radius. Below you can see ad read more about buffing buildings types:
[h3]🔸 We will start from [b]Production Buff[/b] - modifies production volume.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/56d176e00d1ad9401e871151b6f1713f4f3a8f6c.png[/img]

[h3]🔹 Next one is [b]Cooldown Buff[/b] reduction - reduces the cooldown on all types of buildings and traps.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/81fe2f309271b434caa393ca258e404255e6b850.png[/img]

[h3]🔸 Another one is [b]Damage Buff[/b] - increases the damage for Active buildings and damaging traps.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/99466a4bce03d3d03989907289e8771b2b86d4db.png[/img]

[h3]🔹 [b]Status Buff[/b] increases the status chance to all damage effects in radius.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/99ead3f21a2e01367c7fa3cb396122bede91deb7.png[/img]

[h3]🔸 [b]Defense Buff[/b] increases defense - adds damage resistance to all buildings and friendly units in radius.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/cf695db05240dd54a0533713892cc700bf4cc33f.png[/img]

[h3]🔹 Last on the list, but no less important is [b]Health Buff[/b] regeneration. This is for buildings and units.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/5604a54bbf4441fb98b8ce469f07c8215d415cc3.png[/img]

That's it for today, write which building in this category you think will be the most valuable during the game and if you missed the devlog about the most important building in the game - ZIGGURAT - make sure to check the link below. Stay tuned! 😊

notes.title: DEVLOG #5 | ENEMY HEROSES
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello and Welcome![/b] 👺[/h3]

Dear fans, in today's devlog we will present to you two enemy heroes - [b]Abasdarhon[/b] and [b]Charenmeine[/b]. As in the case of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1489310/view/3103537280736717434]Ghouls[/url] we talked about some time ago, in future devlogs we will tell a little more about the auras of enemy heroes. So stay tuned! 😊

Our opponents will also be able to strengthen their skills by leveling their characters. This time you can see what Abasdarhon and Charenmeine will look like based on their first and second levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/b1e9ca5f5c9314599c736578e07be70a30508fc4.png[/img]

[b]Abasdarhon his basic skills are:[/b]
[list]
[*] Melee - strong magical attacks.
[*] Resistance to physical damage. 
[*] Medium movement speed, can fly to clear obstacles.
[*] Blessing of Divinity - removes all status effects from allies in the area and destroys raised undead.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/e204c83ee944b71061ddffbade5c9e3800dd1ea2.png[/img]

As you may have noticed, these two characters have two things in common - long melee weapons and wings. Thanks to these two characteristic features, they can attack from a distance, which can be deadly for our defense units. ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/560d6302e6878eb3facfe1b53f8e28edae7d92e8.png[/img]

[b]Charenmeine basic skills are:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ranged - fast magical attacks.
[*] Resistance to magical damage.
[*] Fast movement speed, can hover in the air to avoid melee attacks. 
[*] Time of Judgement - a ranged aoe attack that curses enemies in the area
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/f6e55c10286ca091fef9794fb77056fa9076c9b0.png[/img]

Which of these two enemy heroes do you fear the most? Let us know in a comment section or on our Discord server. 👇

notes.title: DEVLOG #4 | GHOULS
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello and Welcome![/b][/h3]

Dear fans, in today's devlog we will present to you three representatives of Ghouls - [b]Touthstalker, Featherslobber and Girgoc[/b]. In the next devlogs we will tell more about the "aura" that Ghouls have, but today we will focus more on presenting this extremely interesting category of monsters.

In NecroCity, Ghouls are special characters that become available to the player after a certain point in the story. They can be summoned from the main building and sent to any point on the map, in a similar way to the melee units. All ghouls can be leveled up, which improves their stats and unlocks extra special abilities.


So let's start with the [b]Touthstalker[/b]. His basic features and skills are:
[list]
[*] Claw Strike - melee, physically strong and quick attack.
[*] Inspiring aura -  buffs nearby units and raises their health.
[*] Battle Rage - increased attack and speed, cannot be knocked out for the duration.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/8a234728209ccd58487b4d3ab5e1173b6576c1fc.png[/img]


Another representative of this category is [b]Featherslobber[/b]. His basic features and skills are:
[list]
[*] Melodrama - ranged, magical, slow, strong attacks
[*] Melancholic aura - debuffs and slows enemies.
[*] Poetry Reading - stuns all nearby enemies for the duration.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/856a895ce9d39391d417e6d6b66fa8b94e728f63.png[/img]


The last ghoul we will talk about today is [b]Girgoc[/b]. His basic features and skills are:
[list]
[*] Skull Projectile - ranged, physical, quick, but weak attack
[*] Collector aura - increases the number of bones and souls gathered from enemies.
[*] Look over there! - teleports away from the fight and quickly regains health.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/3c48134888440b2b6f88c068c165acd5af3c3483.png[/img]

[b][h3]Which of the presented characters would you take to your dark army? 🤔[/h3][/b]

That's it for today, we will talk a little more about the human race and buildings in the upcoming devlogs. Stay tunned! 😊

notes.title: DEVLOG #3 | ZIGGURAT
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello and Welcome! 👹[/b][/h3]

Today we come back to you with something special for two reasons. First of all, we want to present to you one of the most important (if not the most important) buildings in NecroCity - [b]ZIGGURAT[/b]. In his example, you can also see how the leveling of buildings in the game will look like.

In a game like NecroCity, the development of both characters and buildings is an extremely important aspect during the game, so in the upcoming devlogs we want to show you how the leveling of buildings and characters will look like. Each of the buildings will have its own unique skills in the game. 

Ziggurat is the center of the city, the (non) beating heart of your units and the target of all enemies. The building has its health that slowly restores over time. The enemy starts attacking him the moment they get close to him. Don't let your enemies destroy Ziggurat, you need to protect it at all costs - You'll have to make some tough choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/a8684090d75b42caad955811002eb35f86012afa.png[/img]

Ziggurat has an attack beam with an upgradable cooldown and attack that it uses on all approaching enemies. Protect your it from hordes of the attacking forces of good, they will do anything to destroy it. And as you can see Ziggurat can be upgraded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/556cb1a7151c1f5263dbaf5d68b13d9bf0796115.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/18577068065fc9f8faee1afc7f3f3b5f2914bd06.png[/img]

That's it for today, more information about the game's production, coming soon! 😊

notes.title: DEVLOG | #2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello and Welcome![/b][/h3]

Today we will introduce you to one character that will appear in the game and tell you a little about one of the buildings. Each of the characters will have their own unique skills and today we will focus on [b]Fairy[/b] and tell more about [b]Mine of Bones[/b]. 

🧚‍♀️ We always associate the fairy with a good and flawless character. In NecroCity, her main features will be melee, high health level, she will be able to do high magic damage, but also has high resistance to magic attacks from the enemy, and most importantly, she will be able to fly! Sounds nice? 🤩 And I'd forget, one of our favorite Fairy attacks is the dust attack! 🌬️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/eca66d2eddbf9ac81ba677329b977419638930d9.png[/img]

⛏️ During the construction of our cemetery, we have to plan its construction carefully, each building has an important role to play during the game. One such building is the Mine of Bones, this building belongs to the production buildings and production depends on the number of graveyard tiles in the radius. It is one of the most important buildings during the gameplay, and most importantly, it can be developed in several levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/b71f5aba75ddbeb69eb607e9b7457cbc0a9faed8.png[/img]


In the game, you can expect more and more interesting characters such as skeletons, ghosts, ghouls, the same applies to buildings. That's it for this devlog, if you have any ideas and suggestions for the game, write in the comment and join our community on discord. 😊
